mapper.select: select f.follow_id, f.partner_id, f.follower_id, f.follow_type, f.content, f.next_follow_date, f.next_follow_content, f.status, f.follow_time, f.created_at, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.remark, p.partner_name as partner_name from sys_business_follow f left join sys_partner p on f.partner_id = p.partner_id where f.follow_id = #{followId}
